annotations.text:
Two origins, both yours and both first-hand:

1. Training — too many apps for meals, workouts, measurements and progress; wanting one thing that takes the data, adjusts automatically, and says what to do next.

2. Studio — the gym you train at runs an outdated app; a gym owner should be able to hand members something that works.

Nothing here is invented. Owner-board figures are marked Illustrative.
